reviewNotes: Unreviewed AI translation drafts for German (de) and Italian (it) nursery-to-field planting observation UI. Intended drafting boundaries: (1) Observed field planting is distinguished from planned field entry (UTC calendar date) and saved plan references; (2) Planted count requires an integer number where explicitly entered 0 is zero and blank is uncounted; (3) Observations do not deduct stock, determine survival (sopravvivenza / Überleben, avoiding establishment/attecchimento), or mark batches completed; (4) Checked labels mean user-selected checkbox labels to snapshot (Ausgewählte / selezionate), not verified identity, and do not establish earlier sowing/count records; (5) de10 and de13 clarify source actor (Pflanzen, die Sie gepflanzt haben) and count of planted plants; (6) Withheld evidence pending review remains distinct from an ordinary unlinked note; (7) Exact ASCII literals DEMO, UTC, and 0 are preserved. Terms for human review: naturalness of Anzuchtpartie vs lotto vivaio for raising batches, and Freilandpflanzung vs trapianto in campo in local grower idioms. No runtime activation or semantic certification is claimed.
